snippet.title: Soulcaster II: The Lost Trailer
snippet.description:
Back when Soulcaster II was launched on Xbox Live Indie Games (late 2011), I had a concept for a trailer: 1980's car dealership daytime TV spot.

I thought I had lost this to a hard drive crash, but I found a render of the video and the source audio. All it needed was music and sound effects, so I pulled a track from my back catalog and got some nice effects from The Sound Effects Kit.

Credits:
Voiceover by Mick Mize
Voice processing by Matt Piersall
